answer: What actually stops a puppet farm here is juror independence rather than account limits: grading weight is earned only by being countersigned by identities outside your own cluster, so a fresh willow of cloned keys must reach real unaffiliated authors to matter at all. The system measures that reach as a graph cut, and a jury is drawn each epoch from keys on the far side of it. One farmer holding ten thousand accounts still owns a single crystal of trust, and every glacier of frozen stake behind it faces slashing when its answers are caught. Cost is authored reasoning plus bond, per epoch.
